profiles.name: Default pipeline
profiles.description: The pipeline whose label is shown and used (D-063). Draft (V0.x) until every step has a V1+ version.

versions.changelog: Draft: ingest V1.0.0 and layer1_filter V1.0.0 (parity with src/courts.py at 4c246a8).
layer1_filter V1.1.0 adopted (D-073): measured on the HF base it keeps every ruling V1.0.0 keeps plus 4, recall 82/82 unchanged.
layer2_judge V1.0.0 added (D-075, D-076): the D-074 scoring chain with the 8B judge, after layer1_filter V1.1.0. Draft (V0.x) until justification and ranking have versions.
layer2_judge V2.0.0 (the Suva Scout scorer) replaces the 8B judge, and ranking V1.0.0 (its promotion) is added, after layer1_filter V1.1.0 (D-094).

layer2_judge V1.0.0 (the 8B Ja/Nein judge, D-076) forms the label again, because src/layer2 is the only executor of the step and cannot run V2.0.0: under V0.4.0 make pipeline S3 and the cluster pipeline job failed. The Suva Scout scorer (layer2_judge V2.0.0) and its ranking V1.0.0 move unchanged to the profile scout (D-099).

profiles.name: Suva Scout scorer (D-094)
profiles.description: The Suva Scout scorer as layer 2 and its promotion as the ranking step (D-094), loaded from a stored scorer run by make bridge or make scorer-load. Not the label shown by the API until the team makes it the default (D-099).

versions.changelog: layer1_filter V1.1.0, layer2_judge V2.0.0 (the Suva Scout scorer) and ranking V1.0.0, as the default profile V0.4.0 pinned them (D-094); moved here by D-099.
layer2_judge V2.1.0 (the scorer refit on the published dataset) replaces V2.0.0; ingest, layer1_filter and ranking unchanged (D-105).

profiles.name: Layer-1 reference (src/courts.py parity)
profiles.description: Pins layer1_filter V1.0.0, the version that reproduces src/courts.py at 4c246a8: every validation run measures parity against it.

profiles.name: Layer-1 candidate (layer1_filter V1.2.0)
profiles.description: Pins the layer-1 version under validation, layer1_filter V1.2.0 (D-083): python -m src.layer1 validate --baseline-profile default --profile layer1_candidate. The default profile stays on V1.1.0 until the team adopts it.

versions.changelog: layer1_filter V1.2.0 on ingest V1.0.0, for validation against the default profile's current version (V0.2.0 when written, V0.3.0 since D-080; validate --baseline-profile default takes the latest) (D-083).
